basic_details.short_information: Harish-Chandra Research Institute (HRI), Prayagraj, under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India, has invited applications under Advertisement Notice No. HRI/03/2026 for one post of Consultant (UDC Accounts) on a short-term contract for an initial period of six months. The post is meant for retired UDC or equivalent employees. The hard copy of the application must be sent by Speed Post only to The Registrar, Harish-Chandra Research Institute, Chhatnag Road, Jhunsi, Prayagraj – 211 019 (Uttar Pradesh), on or before 15 December 2026 up to 17:30 hrs.

age_limit.details: Not more than 62 years as on 15.12.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation.

qualification.details: Retired employees who have retired from the post of UDC or an equivalent post in Central Autonomous Bodies, Central Research and Educational institutions, or Central Government Ministries/Departments, and who are well conversant with the functioning of Central Government/Ministries/Departments/Autonomous Bodies. Experience in dealing with Accounts, Pay Bills, Salary Vouchers, GeM Payments, etc. Working knowledge of MS Office and Internet, PFMS, Tally, etc. Personnel retired from Educational and Research Institutes under the Department of Atomic Energy shall be given preference. Only eligible Indian candidates may apply. | Not more than 62 years as on 15.12.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. | The maximum consolidated fee payable shall be Rupees 30,000/- per month, depending upon the educational qualification and length of experience. For retired Government officials, the fee shall not exceed the ceiling of (Last Pay minus Basic Pension). Remuneration is as per the Department of Expenditure's OM No.3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020 on contract appointment of retired Central Government employees. A retired official continues to draw pension and Dearness Relief on pension, and the engagement is not treated as re-employment. Income tax or any other tax is deducted as per the prevalent rules. | The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should read the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post.

selection_process: The Selection Committee of HRI will scrutinize the applications and shortlist candidates based on eligibility. The shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview by the Selection Committee. Any communication will be only through e-mail by HRI. The decision of the Competent Authority on rejection of candidates is final
and no correspondence on this subject will be entertained. The notice mentions no written test and does not give an interview date.
important_instructions: The initial engagement is for six months, and it may be extended as per the requirement of the institute. The appointment is purely temporary. It gives no right to regular appointment, regularization or permanent appointment. The consultant will not be entitled to allowances such as Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, HRA or medical reimbursement. No TA/DA is admissible for joining or on completion. Normal office timings are 9.00 AM to 5.30 PM on working days, including half an hour lunch break. In exigencies of work, the consultant may be required to sit late and may be called on Saturday/Sunday or any other gazetted holiday, with no extra remuneration. Paid leave is 1.5 days for each completed month of service, with no accumulation beyond a calendar year. Either side can end the contract with one month's notice or pay in lieu. HRI may terminate services without notice for continuous absence of more than 15 days beyond the entitled leave in a calendar year. The consultant is subject to the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923, during and after the assignment. Without previous sanction of the Institute, the consultant may not publish a book or take part in a broadcast or write to a newspaper on subject matter assigned by the Institute. The consultant must maintain decorum and discipline as expected of a regular Central Government employee. Matters not covered are guided by HRI/DAE/GoI rules.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: Harish-Chandra Research Institute is an institute of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India, located at Chhatnag Road, Jhunsi, Prayagraj (Allahabad). This is a government institute recruitment, and the consultant will work at the institute under the guidance and supervision of the Accounts Officer, HRI, Prayagraj.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants must send the hard copy of the duly filled-in Application Form by Speed Post only. The self-attested documents must go with it. The postal address given in the notice is: The Registrar, Harish-Chandra Research Institute, Chhatnag Road, Jhunsi, Prayagraj – 211 019 (Uttar Pradesh) The form to use is the "Format of Application" attached to the notice. It carries a box to affix a recent passport size photo. The notice does not say what to write on the envelope. For any query, the notice asks candidates to write to [email protected] . The notice does not give an email address for sending applications. The Format of Application asks for these details: Name in full in block letters, and name in Hindi Date of birth (dd-mm-yyyy) and age as on 15.12.2026 Last post held and pay scale before retirement Last place of work (Institute/CAB/Central Govt.) Details of the job responsibilities held during service Whether the applicant was ever assigned the responsibility of a Consultant, with details Whether any penalty was imposed during service, with details Contact number and e-mail address (both compulsory), address for communication, date and full signature

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Retired employees who have retired from the post of UDC or an equivalent post in Central Autonomous Bodies, Central Research and Educational institutions, or Central Government Ministries/Departments, and who are well conversant with the functioning of Central Government/Ministries/Departments/Autonomous Bodies. Experience in dealing with Accounts, Pay Bills, Salary Vouchers, GeM Payments, etc. Working knowledge of MS Office and Internet, PFMS, Tally, etc. Personnel retired from Educational and Research Institutes under the Department of Atomic Energy shall be given preference. Only eligible Indian candidates may apply. Not more than 62 years as on 15.12.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. The maximum consolidated fee payable shall be Rupees 30,000/- per month, depending upon the educational qualification and length of experience. For retired Government officials, the fee shall not exceed the ceiling of (Last Pay minus Basic Pension). Remuneration is as per the Department of Expenditure's OM No.3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020 on contract appointment of retired Central Government employees. A retired official continues to draw pension and Dearness Relief on pension, and the engagement is not treated as re-employment. Income tax or any other tax is deducted as per the prevalent rules. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should read the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: HRI Consultant (UDC Accounts) Job Description
content_sections.text: Scope of work: dealing with all matters relating to Accounts/Salary/Payments, etc. Reporting: the consultant works under the guidance and supervision of the Accounts Officer, HRI, Prayagraj. Place of work: Harish-Chandra Research Institute, Chhatnag Road, Jhunsi, Prayagraj - 211019.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice, to be self-attested and sent with the application form: Age proof Certificates of educational qualifications Identity proof Experience certificate (PPO/LPC) etc. The application form also has lines for copies of PPO/LPC, copies of Aadhaar/PAN and copies of certificates, each marked "attached".

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Selection Committee of HRI will scrutinize the applications and shortlist candidates based on eligibility. The shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview by the Selection Committee. Any communication will be only through e-mail by HRI. The decision of the Competent Authority on rejection of candidates is final, and no correspondence on this subject will be entertained. The notice mentions no written test and does not give an interview date.

content_sections.text: The initial engagement is for six months, and it may be extended as per the requirement of the institute. The appointment is purely temporary. It gives no right to regular appointment, regularization or permanent appointment. The consultant will not be entitled to allowances such as Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, HRA or medical reimbursement. No TA/DA is admissible for joining or on completion. Normal office timings are 9.00 AM to 5.30 PM on working days, including half an hour lunch break. In exigencies of work, the consultant may be required to sit late and may be called on Saturday/Sunday or any other gazetted holiday, with no extra remuneration. Paid leave is 1.5 days for each completed month of service, with no accumulation beyond a calendar year. Either side can end the contract with one month's notice or pay in lieu. HRI may terminate services without notice for continuous absence of more than 15 days beyond the entitled leave in a calendar year. The consultant is subject to the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923, during and after the assignment. Without previous sanction of the Institute, the consultant may not publish a book or take part in a broadcast or write to a newspaper on subject matter assigned by the Institute. The consultant must maintain decorum and discipline as expected of a regular Central Government employee. Matters not covered are guided by HRI/DAE/GoI rules.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in HRI Consultant (UDC Accounts) recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy: 01 (One post) of Consultant (UDC Accounts) at Harish-Chandra Research Institute, Prayagraj, under Advertisement Notice No. HRI/03/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 December 2026 (Tuesday), up to 17:30 hrs. The hard copy must be sent by Speed Post only.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the HRI Consultant post?
faq.answer: Eligible Indian retired employees who retired from the post of UDC or an equivalent post in Central Autonomous Bodies, Central Research and Educational institutions, or Central Government Ministries/Departments can apply. They must have experience in Accounts, Pay Bills, Salary Vouchers or GeM Payments and working knowledge of MS Office, Internet, PFMS and Tally.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 62 years as on 15.12.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the HRI Consultant (UDC Accounts)?
faq.answer: The maximum consolidated fee is Rupees 30,000/- per month, depending on educational qualification and length of experience. For retired Government officials it shall not exceed Last Pay minus Basic Pension.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the duly filled-in Application Form in hard copy by Speed Post only, with self-attested age proof, educational certificates, identity proof and experience certificate (PPO/LPC) etc., to The Registrar, Harish-Chandra Research Institute, Chhatnag Road, Jhunsi, Prayagraj – 211 019 (Uttar Pradesh).

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The Selection Committee will scrutinize applications and shortlist candidates based on eligibility. The shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview by the Selection Committee, and communication will be only through e-mail by HRI.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a short-term contract for an initial six months, which may be extended as per requirement of the institute. It gives no right to regularization or permanent appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Will HRA or other allowances be paid on top of the fee?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the consultant will not be entitled to allowances such as Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, HRA or medical reimbursement. No TA/DA is admissible for joining or on completion.

faq.question: Q10. Can a retired person continue to draw pension while working as Consultant?
faq.answer: Yes. A retired Government official engaged as Consultant continues to draw pension and Dearness Relief on pension. The engagement is not treated as re-employment, and the fee shall not exceed Last Pay minus Basic Pension.
